svg.title: Generate one token, then repeat
svg.desc: A token stamping press feeding a growing paper strip. Fluent continuation does not establish truth, authority, or a plan.
svg.text: The prompt is already a sequence of tokens: [Write] [a] [safe] [tool] [call].
The transformer computes a distribution over possible next tokens.
Illustrative scores are { 0.41, "tool" 0.32, call 0.17, and other 0.10. Selection
is a separate step from scoring.
Append the selected token, here {, to context and compute the next distribution.
Fluent continuation does not establish truth, authority, or a plan.
